ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of low-intensity dark pigment to high-intensity white/light-grey mottled regions across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity patch on the right lobe distal quadrant. Multiple high-intensity linear streaks and small circular clusters on the left lobe. High-intensity circular clusters concentrated at both distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; central apex is partially obscured by water turbulence, but the converging linear boundaries indicate an acute angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Frequent irregular serrations along both trailing edges; the right lobe exhibits higher amplitude peaks and deeper valleys compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curves sweeping upwards and outwards towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast circular pixel clusters (barnacles) at the extreme tips of both lobes, with smaller white point clusters scattered across the dark-pigmented regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of unaligned, high-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) traversing the dark pigment on both lobes, most concentrated on the inner sections near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the central fluke surface and heavy barnacle encrustation localized on the distal margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Two prominent, nearly vertical parallel white streaks on the right lobe immediately adjacent to the median notch.
